dict.Desen: desenează de mână cu creionul, ma: Drawing: draw freehand with the pen, highlighter and eraser; the drawing is inserted at the cursor as a picture
Drawing: draw freehand with the pen, highlighter and eraser; the drawing is placed over the cells as a picture
dict.Desenul e pe foaie: trage de el ca să-l: The drawing is on the sheet: drag it to move it, drag the bottom-right corner to resize it; Delete removes it
dict.Desenul nu a putut fi pus pe foaie: The drawing could not be placed on the sheet
dict.Desenează cu mouse-ul, cu creionul table: Draw with the mouse, a tablet pen or your finger. On “✓ Done” the drawing is inserted as a picture (only the lines, no background).
dict.Pune desenul ca poză (Esc sau Enter): Insert the drawing as a picture (Esc or Enter)
dict.Lasou (L): încercuiește liniile ca să le: Lasso (L): circle lines to select them, then drag them to move them; Delete removes them
